xmldoc.short_description: Returns the libraries a native nflow block plugin must link against.

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of library paths without extension. dlgeneratemake appends the platform suffix (.lib on Windows, .so or .dylib otherwise).

description.p: C = dlgetnflowlibraries() returns the libraries needed to link a native nflow block plugin.

A plugin calls the simulation helpers (getInput, getState, setOutput, updated, and others), which are compiled into nlsNflow_blocks. Linking that single library is enough; its own Nelson dependencies are resolved at load time.
This function is typically passed to dlgeneratemake.
